spec.name: Halloween Bottled Boo
spec.description: A pocket-sized glass jar holding one friendly white ghost, sealed with a cork and tied with an orange bow. Sparse violet glass glints preserve a clear view of the ghost and transparent space around it. Axis-aligned, editable collectible for Orange SMP.

prompt: Small glass jar with cork and one cute white ghost visible inside, violet glints, orange ribbon. Readable held collectible. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
